question: Among never-served loop-forming world edges, does the confirmed direct-count association survive measured loop retention and strength, and does retention survive the cycle at which the loop first appeared?
scope: Post-hoc extension on the same twelve consumed seeds, one compositional world family, 120 cycles, cap 40. No fresh seed.

definitions.retention: Observed loop span, (last reported loop cycle - first reported loop cycle + 1), divided by the cycles available from first detection to cycle 120. Bounded (0, 1]; single-cycle loops are not assigned zero.
definitions.strength: Maximum loop_candidate.strength over all reported loops containing the edge in either orientation. Strength is the within-loop minimum temporal edge count, so it is a measured carrier property.
definitions.formation: First reported loop cycle for the edge divided by 120, in (0, 1]. The control is linear in this fraction; it does not model a nonlinear onset effect.
definitions.population: The confirmed block's 177 never-served loop-forming edges; replay must reproduce each seed's loop edge set and loop cycles exactly.
definitions.seed: twelve-level fixed effect, first seed as reference

models.baseline: logit P(asserted) = b0 + b_rank*z(log2(min_rank)) + b_count*z(direct_count) + seed fixed effects
models.controlled: extended + b_formation*z(formation); formation is the first loop cycle as a fraction of the 120-cycle run

inference: Post hoc and descriptive. Coefficients, intervals, in-sample AUC/Brier, correlations, strength quartiles and leave-one-seed-out folds are reported; no confirmatory verdict and no multiplicity-adjusted claim. The formation control is a linear covariate for first-detection timing, not a causal identification strategy.
not_evidence: A post-hoc observational extension in one synthetic world family on already-consumed seeds. Retention and strength are measured, not manipulated. The formation control is a linear covariate for first-detection timing, not a randomisation or an identification strategy. Attenuation is consistent with a proxy reading but does not establish mediation, causation, capability, transfer or a general engine property.
